batch.title: Identity, tenant isolation, and privileged execution
batch.goal: Complete trusted acting context, memberships, capabilities, revocation, RLS, actor-bound RPCs, service jobs, storage policy, and audit enforcement.
exitCriteria: Org A, Org B, revoked, stale, unauthenticated, and technical-principal tests pass through API and direct data access.
No critical elevation, actor-binding, or tenant-isolation finding remains open.

findings.title: Authenticated-wide RLS on financial_transactions, budgets, equipment_*, workflow_*, travel/lodging family = cross-org read/write
findings.solution: Org-scoped policies (pattern: work_mode_publications); extend REL-101 matrix
acceptanceCriteria: Blocker removed; regression test passes; negative/staging verification passes; equivalent bypass absent.
verificationRequirements: Static + automated negative test + seeded staging verification + explicit sign-off.

findings.title: Self-service admin escalation: surface gate accepts profiles.account_type/is_admin/organizer_data; owner-update RLS unguarded
findings.solution: Gate admin on org_members+grants only; DB trigger blocking self-elevation; runtime repro NEEDS_VERIFICATION
acceptanceCriteria: Blocker removed; regression test passes; negative/staging verification passes; equivalent bypass absent.
verificationRequirements: Static + automated negative test + seeded staging verification + explicit sign-off.

findings.title: Shift publish skips permission checks for org shifts (null venue_id bypasses loop)
findings.solution: Check org authority when venue_id null
acceptanceCriteria: Launch-critical workflow/security boundary works end-to-end with correct tenant scoping.
verificationRequirements: Unit/integration + seeded two-org persona test + API/DB evidence.

findings.title: tour_events RLS insert/update/delete accept is_tour_owner alone - cross-org event attach possible via direct API
findings.solution: Require event org match in WITH CHECK even for tour owners
acceptanceCriteria: Launch-critical workflow/security boundary works end-to-end with correct tenant scoping.
verificationRequirements: Unit/integration + seeded two-org persona test + API/DB evidence.

findings.title: org_members.role unconstrained free text; 6 parallel role taxonomies drift
acceptanceCriteria: Behavior is consistent, documented, tested and free of material integrity/usability/scale defect.

findings.title: Two divergent capability services (/api/admin/capabilities vs effective-capabilities); DB perm vocabulary disjoint from ADMIN_CAPABILITIES
acceptanceCriteria: Behavior is consistent, documented, tested and free of material integrity/usability/scale defect.

findings.title: Idempotency-Key enforcement is in-memory Map only; duplicates across serverless instances
acceptanceCriteria: Behavior is consistent, documented, tested and free of material integrity/usability/scale defect.

findings.title: Audit logging: ~6/288 admin route files write audit rows despite central helpers
findings.solution: Adopt helper in command pipeline / registry contract
acceptanceCriteria: Behavior is consistent, documented, tested and free of material integrity/usability/scale defect.

findings.title: user_sessions table not in active migration chain; acting-context persistence silently degrades
findings.solution: Add migration or document header-only mode
acceptanceCriteria: Behavior is consistent, documented, tested and free of material integrity/usability/scale defect.

findings.title: Stale acting-context silently demoted server-side with no client signal
acceptanceCriteria: Polish/debt item resolved or explicitly accepted with rationale.

findings.title: switch_active_account SECURITY DEFINER RPC trusts caller-supplied user/profile identity
findings.solution: Derive actor from auth.uid(); validate profile/account membership; restrict EXECUTE; add cross-user negative tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Blocker removed; regression test passes; negative/staging verification passes; equivalent bypass absent.
verificationRequirements: Static + automated negative test + seeded staging verification + explicit sign-off.

findings.title: get_user_accounts_adaptive allows arbitrary target-user account discovery
findings.solution: Bind ordinary lookup to auth.uid(); isolate privileged cross-user lookup behind explicit grant/service principal.
acceptanceCriteria: Blocker removed; regression test passes; negative/staging verification passes; equivalent bypass absent.
verificationRequirements: Static + automated negative test + seeded staging verification + explicit sign-off.

findings.title: create_artist_account trusts caller identity and contains WHERE user_id = user_id mass-update defect
findings.solution: Use auth.uid(); rename parameters; scope update correctly; wrap mutation transactionally; add multi-user regression tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Blocker removed; regression test passes; negative/staging verification passes; equivalent bypass absent.
verificationRequirements: Static + automated negative test + seeded staging verification + explicit sign-off.

findings.title: send_dm_request permits caller-controlled sender identity
findings.solution: Derive sender from auth.uid(); remove actor arg; validate recipient/block state; restrict EXECUTE; test impersonation.
acceptanceCriteria: Blocker removed; regression test passes; negative/staging verification passes; equivalent bypass absent.
verificationRequirements: Static + automated negative test + seeded staging verification + explicit sign-off.

findings.title: get_or_create_conversation accepts arbitrary user pairs without strong actor binding
findings.solution: Bind one participant to auth.uid(); privileged override only via explicit service/admin path.
acceptanceCriteria: Launch-critical workflow/security boundary works end-to-end with correct tenant scoping.
verificationRequirements: Unit/integration + seeded two-org persona test + API/DB evidence.

findings.title: Organizer-account discovery RPC accepts arbitrary user target
findings.solution: Bind standard calls to auth.uid(); privileged directory lookup only via capability/service principal.
acceptanceCriteria: Launch-critical workflow/security boundary works end-to-end with correct tenant scoping.
verificationRequirements: Unit/integration + seeded two-org persona test + API/DB evidence.

findings.title: Legacy hiring/permission SECURITY DEFINER RPCs still accept caller-supplied identity
findings.solution: Migrate to authenticated acting-context pattern; reduce SECURITY DEFINER surface; standardize permission service.
acceptanceCriteria: Launch-critical workflow/security boundary works end-to-end with correct tenant scoping.
verificationRequirements: Unit/integration + seeded two-org persona test + API/DB evidence.

specTasks.title: Acting account
acceptanceCriteria: How an Admin selects an organization, how it is signed into the session, and how ambiguous membership is rejected

specTasks.title: Ownership
acceptanceCriteria: Organization creator/master invariants, transfer behavior, and whether every tour/event must have an organization owner

specTasks.title: Capabilities
acceptanceCriteria: Capability catalog, default roles, custom roles, inheritance, and emergency support access

specTasks.title: Deletion/retention
acceptanceCriteria: Archive versus delete for tours/events and retention requirements for finance, tickets, contracts, incidents, and audit logs

specTasks.title: Inventory deployed database policies and grants
acceptanceCriteria: Automated export lists tables, RLS enabled state, policies, functions, triggers, grants, and migration versions; drift from repository is reviewed and stored securely.

blockers.reason: Canonical SELECT-only database exporter, deterministic drift comparator, secure evidence rules, and manual runbook are complete; isolated-branch and Tourify Demo exports/advisors/sign-off are required

specTasks.title: Approve acting-context ADR
acceptanceCriteria: Session format, switch behavior, multi-tab behavior, expiry, support access, and `409` contract are documented with threat model.

specTasks.title: Approve capability matrix
acceptanceCriteria: Every Admin navigation item and API command maps to one or more capabilities and default roles; product/security sign off.

blockers.reason: Every canonical sidebar leaf and registered API method now resolves to catalog capabilities/default roles with fail-closed unknown navigation and high-risk overlays; generated review artifact still requires named product/security sign-off

specTasks.title: Create two-org security fixture
acceptanceCriteria: Fixture includes one multi-org user, distinct owners, managers, viewers, workers, and parent/child records in all audited domains.

blockers.reason: Deterministic valid UUIDs, symmetric roles, explicit multi-org memberships, and distinct parent/child identities now cover all 11 audited domains; canonical contract persistence and isolated DB seed/RLS execution are still absent

specTasks.title: Implement signed acting context
acceptanceCriteria: Server resolves the same org as the visible account switcher; tampered/missing values fail safely; switching invalidates org-scoped caches.

blockers.reason: Expand-only manual SQL adds per-auth-session profile/org/epoch/expiry/revocation/version state, restricted own-session CAS/resolve/revoke RPCs, and immutable audit; HMAC envelope/session binding/full cache-key primitives and 7 tests pass, but isolated SQL evidence, signing-key configuration, server route cutover, and client switch/stale-tab integration remain

specTasks.title: Implement capability service
acceptanceCriteria: Effective capabilities combine system role, custom role, creator/master invariant, membership state, and scoped grants; unit tests cover precedence and expiry.

specTasks.title: Create route/command wrappers
acceptanceCriteria: New Admin endpoints cannot execute without context, schema validation, required capability, target assertion, correlation ID, and structured error mapping.

specTasks.title: Add/backfill tenant keys
acceptanceCriteria: Finance, logistics, staffing, site-map, ticketing, and child tables receive validated `org_id`; unresolvable rows move to a quarantine table/view and are inaccessible to normal users.

specTasks.title: Replace finance RLS
acceptanceCriteria: Blanket authenticated policies are dropped; select/insert/update/delete require effective organization relationship and suitable capability/service function.

specTasks.title: Replace logistics RLS
acceptanceCriteria: Travel, flight, passenger, lodging, guest, transport, rental, and child policies prevent parent-ID and child-ID bypasses.

specTasks.title: Replace legacy ticketing RLS
acceptanceCriteria: Permissive policies are explicitly dropped, not shadowed; old tables become migration-only/read-only until retired.

specTasks.title: Constrain service-role use
acceptanceCriteria: Service role exists only in named internal modules/jobs; every call supplies verified org and reason; client-supplied org/target values are revalidated.

specTasks.title: Add organization predicates to mutations
acceptanceCriteria: Update/delete queries include target ID and acting `org_id`; child mutations validate the parent chain inside the same transaction.

specTasks.title: Implement immutable security audit
acceptanceCriteria: Privileged reads/exports and every mutation write an append-only result event; audit failures follow an approved fail-closed/fail-open policy by action class.

specTasks.title: Add authorization contract tests
acceptanceCriteria: Endpoint tests cover owner, role, custom role, expired/revoked membership, wrong org, guessed ID, child ID, bulk IDs, share token, and service job.

specTasks.title: Retire owner-only tour authorization
acceptanceCriteria: Legacy routes delegate to canonical org/entity authorization; valid collaborators receive consistent behavior across every command-center tab.

specTasks.title: Introduce state-aware authorization
acceptanceCriteria: Published, active, settled, archived, and legally retained records enforce stronger actions and approval/separation-of-duties rules.

specTasks.title: Add field-level protected-data policy
acceptanceCriteria: Traveler PII, accessibility/dietary data, financial details, contracts, credentials, and incidents expose only the minimum required fields by role/audience.

specTasks.title: Add delegated/external access model
acceptanceCriteria: Venue/vendor/contractor links grant only named resources/actions, expire automatically, and cannot enumerate organization data.

specTasks.title: Enforce capability-aware UI
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation and controls reflect capability but never replace server enforcement; denied actions explain how to request access without revealing protected data.

specTasks.title: Automated RLS matrix in CI
acceptanceCriteria: Direct authenticated database clients prove cross-org denial for every table/action and valid access for each intended relationship.

specTasks.title: Authorization observability
acceptanceCriteria: Metrics and alerts cover denied spikes, context mismatches, service-role usage, policy errors, and audit-write failures without logging secrets/PII.

specTasks.title: Security review and penetration test
acceptanceCriteria: Independent review covers IDOR, privilege escalation, token leakage, bulk/export bypass, race conditions, webhook replay, and stored-file access; critical/high items are closed.

specTasks.title: Access review workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Organization owners can review members, roles, entity grants, external shares, and recent privileged actions; revoked access takes effect immediately.

specTasks.title: Data-retention controls
acceptanceCriteria: Retention/deletion policies are implemented and tested for audit, finance, tickets, contracts, personnel, incidents, and uploaded documents.

workflows.title: Admin Identity and Acting Organization

producer.outcome: Authenticates and explicitly selects an authorized organization.

recipients.outcome: Sees a shell and data bound to the selected organization.

dataBoundaries.rlsExpectation: The authenticated subject can resolve and switch only to active memberships owned by that subject; stale or revoked context fails closed.

workflows.recipientVisibleResult: The visible organization, server context, API scope, and database scope agree.

recovery.retry: Retry is bounded, idempotent, and exposes the last failure.
recovery.reversal: A reviewed compensating or revocation command restores the prior safe state.
recovery.partialFailure: Partial effects remain visible and resumable; no silent success is returned.

workflows.title: Roles, Capabilities, Grants, and Revocation

producer.outcome: Grants or revokes a role or scoped capability.

recipients.outcome: Receives only the intended capability and loses it immediately when revoked.

dataBoundaries.rlsExpectation: Only active owners or explicitly granted role administrators may change organization-scoped grants; entity grants cannot escape their target.

workflows.recipientVisibleResult: Recipient navigation and server authorization update from the same effective-capability decision.

recovery.retry: Retry is bounded, idempotent, and exposes the last failure.
recovery.reversal: A reviewed compensating or revocation command restores the prior safe state.
recovery.partialFailure: Partial effects remain visible and resumable; no silent success is returned.

references.canonicalSource: Authenticated acting-context and capability command wrappers
invariants: Organization and actor context come from trusted server state.
Every mutation declares capability, target, validation, idempotency, audit, and stable errors.

launchGates.title: SECURITY DEFINER inventory complete
launchGates.acceptance: Every privileged function has actor binding, pinned search path, restricted grants, tests, or an approved removal record.

launchGates.title: Two-organization RLS matrix passes
launchGates.acceptance: Positive and cross-organization negative cases pass for every exposed domain.

launchGates.title: Multi-organization switching and revocation pass
launchGates.acceptance: Switch, stale-tab, revocation, and cache invalidation behave consistently in UI, API, and database.
